# Coding Profile

[![zread](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ask_Zread-_.svg?style=flat&color=00b0aa&labelColor=000000&logo=data%3Aimage%2Fsvg%2Bxml%3Bbase64%%%%2BCjxwYXRoIGQ9Ik00IDEyTDEyIDQiIHN0cm9rZT0iI2ZmZiIgc3Ryb2tlLXdpZHRoPSIxLjUiIHN0cm9rZS1saW5lY2FwPSJyb3VuZCIvPgo8L3N2Zz4K&logoColor=ffffff)](https://zread.ai/iplaylf2/coding-profile)

Source of truth for reusable configuration and environment definitions that
shape a personal coding setup.

The repository is organized into profiles. Each profile README defines its
purpose and maintenance workflow. Profiles that synchronize assets with another
workspace also provide `content-hub.yaml`; other profiles are consumed directly
from this checkout.

## Profiles

- [`profile/agent`](profile/agent/README.md): agent skills and configuration.
- [`profile/repositories`](profile/repositories/README.md): repository-scoped
  editor and workspace assets.
- [`profile/toolbox-images`](profile/toolbox-images/README.md): Fedora Toolbx
  container image definitions.

## Setup

Profiles that use `content-hub.yaml` require the project Python environment.
Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), then
create or update that environment:

```bash
uv sync
```

## Workflow

Start with the relevant profile README for prerequisites, execution context, and
commands. For synchronized profiles, use `contentctl` to deploy or adopt assets,
and edit `content-hub.yaml` only when changing synchronized paths, workspace
targets, or inclusion and exclusion rules.

Repository formatting and spell-checking commands are documented in
[`.dev/README.md`](.dev/README.md).
